THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and LandDevelopment hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose amd will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

Four (4) allotments of land in extent of 0.6728 Hectare (A: 01,R: 02, P: 26.02), depicted as Lots ‘A’, ‘B’, ‘C’, ‘D’ in the AdvanceTracing No. MR/HKM/2014/170 prepared by the Surveyor-General,situated in the Village of Muruthamure in Grama Niladhari Divisionof Muruthamure in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Hakmana inMatara District.

01. Lot ‘A’ – Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta – Extent:0.1230 HectareNorth and East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Lots B and C;West: Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta claimed by G. K. SunilShantha.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Extent: 0.0423 Hectare
03. Lot ‘C’ – Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta – Extent:0.4719 HectareNorth: Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta claimed by G. K.Sunil Shantha and Lot A; East: Lot B, Kotugodella alias

Kotugodella Watta claimed by C. Weerakoon and others and Lot D;South: Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta claimed by C. Weerakoonand others, Lot D and land reserved for the Canal; West:Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta claimed by Agrarian ServiceCentre..

04. Lot ‘D’ – Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta – Extent:0.0356 HectareNorth: Lot C; East: Kotugodella alias Kotugodella Watta claimedby C. Weerakoon and others and land reserved for the Canal; South:Land reserved for the Canal; West: Lot C.
